d: Calvin attempts to plan a bachelor party against Laura's will; Malik struggles with putting together a toy for his daughter.
Curtis wants to build his Sauce Boss brand and Ella needs to get women to register for the church's help center to receive a much-needed grant.
Ella runs a gun buy-back program at the Help Center; Curtis wants to volunteer at the Help Center.
Calvin and Laura put their engagement to the test, joining pre-marital counseling.
The unfortunate news about a young firefighter forces C.J. to have a transparent conversation with Malik and Jazmine; Miranda discovers she's missing more than just the companionship of a man.
To Curtis' horror, Floyd and Glo begin dating and want to double-date with him and Ella; Pookie and Peanut ask CJ to mentor them when they decide to become firefighters.
Curtis must deal with resentment after he is called back to work.
Ella has become conflicted with the politics of her church and has to make a big decision; Floyd worries that his past behavior might get him canceled and hurt his business.

After Glo exchanges harsh words with Curtis she gives him 210lbs of pork that a butcher-friend gave her; Curtis is suspicious of the gesture and begins piecing together an unlikely tale of matricide and cannibalism.
Kaleb is putting extreme pressure on Jazmine to have sex with him for her first time, but Calvin comes in and rains on their parade.
Malik and Summer have their marriage annulled; Miranda temps at the office when Janine needs an assistant.
Calvin feels some type of way when Miranda gets swept off her feet, causing him to make an epic mistake; a chain letter changes C.J. and Ella's fortune.
Ella helps a victim of domestic abuse; Jazmine and C.J. prepare for the father-daughter dance.
Curtis and Ella keep popping in unannounced to CJ and Janine's; Jazmine is accused of cheating on an exam, but she's covering for a friend.
C.J.'s recurring back problem forces him to face an even bigger issue.
Ella claims she didn't smoke, although her lipstick was found on the vape pen.

st: Going to the Chapel and Not Getting Married
d: When Ella learns Curtis went behind her back and put Miranda on a $500 budget to plan their wedding renewal, she debates whether she should marry Curtis all over again.
Malik is hesitant to give the news to his family about Lisa's pregnancy.

Jazmine reminds a forgetful C.J. about his first wedding anniversary; Curtis and Ella bring over a cake called No Bueno to celebrate, only to learn there is no celebration to be had; Calvin prepares to attend Pookie's wedding solo.
Calvin and C.J. plan an anniversary celebration for Miranda and Janine.
After taking a hit from a vape pen, Curtis seems to think he is now an addict.

It looks like someone is occupying the old Caskey house; Curtis enlists C.J. to help him investigate it; when Curtis alerts C.J., Lisa overhears and adds fuel to the fire, stating she saw some suspicious activity happen outside that house.
Curtis becomes the neighborhood watch Captain and the power goes to his head, much to the demise of the family; Jazmine tries to convince CJ and Malik that they can enjoy the games with healthy food.
Miranda takes Calvin to court for more child support; CJ has had it with Lisa; Calvin and Miranda have mixed feelings about their divorce.
Miranda visits Ella with secret hopes of running into Calvin; Lisa goes to Curtis and Ella after her argument with Malik seeking advice; Curtis cuts down Ella's flower bed by accident.
Curtis and Floyd go on a popular TV show where they pitch their BBQ sauce to potential investors, but their nonstop arguing puts their prospective deals in jeopardy.
Curtis puts Ellas' big day in peril, and Malik takes a class that doesn't go over well with the family.
Ella's online shopping gets her in trouble; Lisa challenges Malik to stay off his phone.
Malik confesses to Curtis that he thinks Lisa is pregnant.
Calvin wants Calvin Jr. to play football, but Ella thinks football is too dangerous and pushes him to play tennis instead.

When Ella discovers the Help Center has fallen into disrepair, she talks Curtis into lending the church money from their savings to fix it up; the couple soon butt heads over the fastest way to get their money back.
A concerned Calvin enlists his quirky friends Pookie and Peanut to help his struggling son, Calvin Jr., with math.

Curtis is planning a block party to launch his food truck and business, Sauce Bosses, when Gloria, a new neighbor, and the new H.O.A. president, shows up and enforces violation codes, shutting down the party; Curtis declares war.
Curtis is convinced that a technologically advanced gift is determined to ruin his life; a local photographer approaches Lisa, but he may not be all he seems.
Calvin becomes a victim of social injustice when he's accused of stealing car tags.

Jazmine becomes a social media influencer and considers leaving college; CJ accidentally steals her thunder, revealing the fickle nature of internet fame; Calvin and Christian come down with a cold and Laura steps up to take care of them.
Jazmine gets a lesson on servitude from Ella; Jazmine is pressured to have sex before she is ready; Ella finds out that Curtis may have slept with her sister back in the day.
Ella finds that Malik and Lisa have deep-rooted issues; Ella reaches a new threshold with Curtis.
